author: Frank Asante Van Laarhoven
purpose: Answer one question before TURNING_ROUTE_POPULATION_V1 is designed: how much of the straight-route behaviour survives the F-G5-1 map repair? The Office freeze attributed it to string-pulling; that attribution is retracted as UNMEASURED because 62% of the planner's free space came from unclassified cells. Designing a turning-route population against an unestablished cause would be building a protocol on a guess.

what_changed.single_variable: the occupancy decode: grid = (buf == OCCUPIED) becomes grid = (buf != UNOCCUPIED)

predeclared_outcomes.note: stated BEFORE running so the result cannot be read as whichever story fits
predeclared_outcomes.if_zero_turn_fraction_falls_sharply: the map was the dominant cause; a turning-route population may be unnecessary, or much smaller in scope
predeclared_outcomes.if_zero_turn_fraction_is_similar: string-pulling is confirmed as dominant and TURNING_ROUTE_POPULATION_V1 is justified as originally reasoned
predeclared_outcomes.if_the_planner_now_fails_to_find_routes: the corrected map is far more constrained (28.4% free vs 75.1%); a high PlannerError rate is a legitimate outcome and is reported, not tuned away

forbidden: changing any threshold in response to the result
changing the generator, seed or budget in response to the result
re-running with a different seed and reporting the better outcome
relationship_to_frozen_results: This does NOT overwrite or amend HOSPITAL_BO10_FROZEN_ROUTESET or OFFICE_BO10_FROZEN_ROUTESET. Those remain valid measurements of what the pipeline produced under the old decode. This is a separate measurement under a repaired instrument.
